image_description: A high-angle shot of a wooden cutting board featuring two meat cleavers. The top cleaver is new, with a yellow protective paper wrapper covering the upper part of the blade and handle area, showing some text and graphics. The bottom cleaver is older, with a heavily worn, pitted, or stained metal surface on the blade face, lacking any handle visibility in this crop (handle likely off-frame or obscured). The background includes a glimpse of a blue object in the top left corner.
